CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "accessToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "accountId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "idToken" text,
  "password" text,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."literaryWork" (
  "averageTime" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "ongoing" bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  "releaseDate" timestamptz,
  "synopsis" jsonb,
  "tags" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "title" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "type" "LiteraryWorkType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."literaryWorkChapter" (
  "averageTime" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "number" float8 NOT NULL,
  "pages" int4,
  "releaseDate" timestamptz,
  "sourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" jsonb,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."movie" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "duration" int4,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "releaseDate" timestamptz,
  "title" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userChapter" (
  "bookmarked" bool NOT NULL,
  "chapterId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "timeSpent" int4,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "when" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userMovie" (
  "bookmarked" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "movieId" text NOT NULL,
  "progress" int4,
  "rating" float8,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "when" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userVideo" (
  "bookmarked" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "progress" int4,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "videoId" text NOT NULL,
  "when" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userVideoGame" (
  "bookmarked" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "offset" int4,
  "review" text,
  "score" float8,
  "timeSpent" int4,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "videoGameId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userVideoGameRun" (
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "runId" text NOT NULL,
  "timeSpent" int4,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."video" (
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "duration" int4,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "link" text,
  "playlistId" text,
  "releaseDate" timestamptz,
  "title" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."videoChannel" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "externalId" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "link" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."videoGame" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "releaseDate" timestamptz,
  "title" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."videoGameRun" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "videoGameId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."videoPlaylist" (
  "channelId" text,

  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
